name: POST /api/leadflow/sequences/tick - advance every active enrolment, exactly once per due step
description:
THE ACCEPTANCE CRITERION IS A UNIQUE CONSTRAINT (d38a1e71-d293-4cc5-9371-1c9b92163b49#AC1). "Running the tick twice in the same minute produces exactly one send per due step" cannot be achieved by checking whether a step has run: two ticks a millisecond apart both read "step 4 has not run" and both send. So a step is CLAIMED by INSERT against UNIQUE (enrollment_id, step_number), and a refused insert means another tick owns it. MEASURED LIVE: two consecutive ticks returned steps_claimed 1 then steps_claimed 0.

CLAIMED IS NOT SENT. dispatched reports what the provider actually accepted, because a claimed step whose send failed must not look like a message the prospect received. The two counts are separate for that reason.

SEND WINDOWS DIFFER BY CHANNEL (d38a1e71-d293-4cc5-9371-1c9b92163b49#AC2). Calls and voicemails are gated on BUSINESS hours through the named business calendar; SMS goes through the full eligibility gate including recipient-local quiet hours; email has no window beyond suppression. Treating them alike would either block harmless email or permit calls nobody wants.

EVERY STEP WRITES ITS NEXT (d38a1e71-d293-4cc5-9371-1c9b92163b49#AC3) and completes the previous one, so a cadence cannot leave a record without an owner action between touches.

THE CIRCUIT BREAKER OPENS AFTER FIVE CONSECUTIVE FAILURES and half-opens after fifteen minutes (d38a1e71-d293-4cc5-9371-1c9b92163b49#AC4). A breaker that never retries is an outage that outlives the outage. Every refusal and deferral is written to the guard log, so a cadence that has gone quiet is explainable rather than mysterious. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A tick reports what it claimed, suppressed and dispatched
Re-ticking claims nothing it has already claimed
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
